name: Mona is a Harsh Mistress
source:
It isn't easy maintaining a moon base with medieval technology.

As a member of the High Lunar Order, it is your job to ensure the ancient rituals keeping your lunar monastery are maintained. Something is wrong, but no one knows what. Unfortunately, monks can be just as petty as any other coworker, especially when everyone is a cat. Interview the other members of the High Lunar Order to find the source of a problem with the air before it's too late.

[From [url=https://ice-husky.itch.io/mona-is-a-harsh-mistress]Itch.io[/url]]
